title: Storage Peek+
description: Left-click chests, barrels, shulker boxes, and large chests to preview their contents without opening them.
body:
# Storage Peek+

**Storage Peek+** is a lightweight quality-of-life mod that lets you quickly preview the contents of storage blocks without opening them.

Simply **left-click** a supported container and a clean preview panel will appear on your screen, showing the items inside in a compact slot grid. It is useful for storage rooms, survival bases, loot hunting, villages, dungeons, fortresses, and any situation where you want to check containers faster.

## How it works

Look at a supported storage block and press **Left Click**.

Instead of opening the container, Storage Peek+ shows a small preview panel with the container name, item icons, stack counts, empty slots, and used slot count. The preview disappears automatically after a few seconds.

The mod also behaves cleanly during normal gameplay. If you hold left click to break a block, the preview will not appear. If you open the container normally, the preview closes instantly.

## Features

* **Left-click container preview** – quickly check containers without opening them.
* **Clean slot grid UI** – shows item icons, stack counts, empty slots, and container name.
* **Large chest support** – double chests show a correct 54-slot preview.
* **Smart break detection** – preview does not interrupt block breaking.
* **Auto-close behavior** – preview closes when breaking or opening a container.
* **Empty container message** – clearly shows when a container has nothing inside.
* **Used slot counter** – displays how many slots are currently filled.
* **Treasure loot detection** – single chests can show special messages for valuable loot.
* **Valuable item glow** – highlights emerald, gold, enchanted golden apple, diamond, and netherite items.
* **Particles and sounds** – special feedback for valuable loot found in single chests.
* **Lightweight and vanilla-friendly** – improves storage checking without changing vanilla container mechanics.

## Supported Containers

* Chest
* Trapped Chest
* Large Chest
* Large Trapped Chest
* Barrel
* Shulker Box

Single containers show a 27-slot preview. Large chests show a 54-slot preview.

## Supported Version

* Minecraft **1.20.1** – Forge

Storage Peek+ is made for players who want faster storage checking, smoother container management, and a simple way to preview loot without breaking the vanilla feel of Minecraft.
